title: Waqf signs in the mushaf: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 2 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Waqf signs in the mushaf rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 2. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Why 36:76 is lazim
points: Joining would make 'We know ...' sound like their words

panels.title: Stopping and restarting
points: Stop on a sukoon (tanween fathah becomes aa)
Never restart in the middle of a phrase

head: Not this
This
rows: Stopping at ۙ (la) because you ran out of breath
Breathe earlier; at ۙ continue, or go back and restart

keywords.def: reciting each letter with its right and its rules

questions.q: Read 2:2 «ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى» and show the two allowed stops.
questions.a: Stop after رَيْبَ (then فِيهِ هُدًى joins), or after فِيهِ; never at both (mu'anaqah).

questions.q: Waqf hunt (pupil PDF): find three ۖ and two ۚ in Al-Mulk and say what you would do at each. Today's rota group recites Juz' Tabarak placement surahs.
Extend: write the six signs with their meanings from memory.
questions.a: ۘ lazim; ۙ la; ۚ ja'iz; ۖ continuing better; ۗ stopping better; ۛ mu'anaqah.

questions.q: Stretch: explain how a wrong stop could change a meaning, using 36:76.
questions.a: Joining قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ could suggest 'We know' is the disbelievers' saying.
A) You must stop. ۘ is waqf lazim: joining would give a wrong meaning.

questions.q: Think again: 'Let's eat, Grandma' and 'Let's eat Grandma': one comma changes everything. How could a stop change the meaning of an ayah?
questions.a: Stopping in the wrong place can join or split meanings wrongly; the waqf signs protect the meaning.
